import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_clean = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_clean.unique():
    mask = sleep_disorder_clean == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=disorder)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='best')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
ax2.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color=colors[0])
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep (hrs)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sleep by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity by BMI Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
bmi_categories = df['BMI Category'].unique()
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#2ecc71'}
for bmi in bmi_categories:
    mask = df['BMI Category'] == bmi
    color = bmi_colors.get(bmi, '#3498db')
    ax3.scatter(df[mask]['Stress Level'], df[mask]['Physical Activity Level'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=60, label=bmi, color=color)
ax3.set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\nby BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.legend(fontsize=8)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Distribution of Quality of Sleep
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax4.hist(df['Quality of Sleep'], bins=8, color=colors[2], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    mask = df['Gender'] == gender
    ax5.scatter(df[mask]['Daily Steps'], df[mask]['Heart Rate'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=60, label=gender)
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps\nby Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical variables
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.set_xticklabels(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_yticklabels(ax6.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=9)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
